class.name: IfcConversionBasedUnitWithOffset
class.brief_description: IfcConversionBasedUnitWithOffset is a unit which is converted from another unit by applying a conversion factor and an offset. HISTORY New entity in IFC 2x4. Example: The temperature unit Fahrenheit is based on the temperature unit Kelvin as follows: f = k · 1.8 – 459.67 wherein k is an absolute temperature expressed in Kelvin and f is the same temperature in Fahrenheit.
